headline: Name all 7 tarsal bones of the foot
body:
T = Talus
C = Calcaneus
N = Navicular
M = Medial cuneiform
I = Intermediate cuneiform
L = Lateral cuneiform
C = Cuboid

headline: How many muscles are in your body?
stat_note: more than 600 muscles in your body
body: They come in 3 types: skeletal (moves your bones), cardiac (only in the heart) and smooth (in organ walls like the stomach).

headline: How much blood do your kidneys filter?
body: Healthy kidneys filter about half a cup of blood every minute, removing extra water and waste to make urine.
source: Source: NIDDK (NIH), The Role of Your Kidneys
